id: 08_SHARQ Safety Officer Interview Questions and Answers - Eastern petrochemical com
title: 安全知识问答：制度、红线与不安全行为（国内版）
source_doc: course/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/08_SHARQ Safety Officer Interview Questions and Answers - Eastern petrochemical com.md
author_source: project/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/08_SHARQ Safety Officer Interview Questions and Answers - Eastern petrochemical com（国内版）/src.py

points.K10: 刷涂料、用溶剂的安全措施
points.S1: 不独自做高危实验，不无人值守
points.S2: 方案变了，先评估再动手
points.S4: 溶剂废液和废包装怎么处理

shots.scene: 欣欣站在问答台后，台上亮着问号灯
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands behind a quiz desk with a glowing question-mark lamp and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 安全知识问答，今天十五道题。
overlay: 安全知识问答：制度、红线与不安全行为

shots.scene: 制度手册、红线、挂锁、打叉小人四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a blank rule book, a red line, a padlock with a blank tag, and a crossed-out person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 制度、红线、上锁，还有不安全行为。

shots.scene: 阿杰在实验室里和同学打闹，手套挂在脖子上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student jokes around in the lab, playfully poking at the air, with his gloves hanging around his neck instead of on his hands.
shots.narration: 阿杰在实验室里嬉闹，手套也没戴。

shots.scene: 地上散落着纸箱，通道被堵住
shots.prompt_en: Cardboard boxes scattered on a lab floor block the walkway to the exit. No people.
shots.narration: 地上堆着纸箱，通道也堵了。

shots.scene: 小研拿着空白检查表走来，摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks in with a blank checklist and shakes her head.
shots.narration: 小研来检查，一下就看出两个问题。

shots.scene: 欣欣在问答台前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the quiz desk and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 是哪两个问题？最后揭晓。

shots.scene: 一本空白规程手册，里面几页带勾的步骤
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure book open to pages with numbered blank steps and green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：什么是安全工作制度？

shots.scene: 按步骤走的小人图标，事故图标变小
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram following steps on a path while an accident icon shrinks in the background. No people.
shots.narration: 按一套程序干活，把事故降到最低。

shots.scene: 空白许可单图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank permit form with a signature line and a stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 作业许可，就是典型的安全工作制度。

shots.scene: 八个作业图标排成两行
shots.prompt_en: Eight icons in two rows: a toolbox, a flame, a manhole, a lightning bolt, a radiation trefoil, a crane hook, a shovel, and a water jet nozzle. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：作业许可有哪几类？

shots.scene: 前四个图标高亮
shots.prompt_en: The toolbox, flame, manhole and lightning bolt icons highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 一般、动火、受限空间、电气。

shots.scene: 后四个图标高亮
shots.prompt_en: The radiation trefoil, crane hook, shovel and water jet icons highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 射线探伤、吊装、开挖、高压水射流。

shots.scene: 十个红色边框的规则卡片排成两列
shots.prompt_en: Ten blank cards with red borders arranged in two columns, each with a small icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：有的企业定了十条保命规则。

shots.scene: 前五张卡片依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The first five cards light up: a rule book, a manhole, a ladder, a crane hook, and a pipe with a valve. No people.
shots.narration: 制度、受限空间、登高、吊装、开管线。

shots.scene: 后五张卡片依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The next five cards light up: a padlock, a floor hole, a disabled alarm, a vehicle, and a change arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 隔离、孔洞、安全系统、车辆、变更。

shots.scene: 通风柜报警器被胶带封住，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fume hood alarm covered with tape, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室也一样：报警别私自关掉。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一条红线前，伸手示意停
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a red line on the floor and holds up a paw to signal stop.
shots.narration: 红线，一条都不能碰。

shots.scene: 一张空白任务卡分成几段
shots.prompt_en: A blank task card splits into four smaller blank cards in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：什么是工作安全分析？

shots.scene: 每段卡片旁写上危害和措施图标
shots.prompt_en: Each small card gets a warning triangle and a shield icon, written on a blank form. No people.
shots.narration: 把活儿拆成步骤，写下危害和措施。

shots.scene: 小研在白板上画四个方框连成一串
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student draws four connected boxes on a whiteboard, the boxes left blank.
shots.narration: 它分四步。

shots.scene: 小研指着第一、二个方框
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at the first two boxes on the whiteboard.
shots.narration: 先选要分析的活，再按顺序拆开。

shots.scene: 小研指着第三、四个方框
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at the last two boxes on the whiteboard.
shots.narration: 找出潜在危害，定好预防措施。

shots.scene: 脚手架上挂着红、黄、绿三色空白标签
shots.prompt_en: A simple scaffold icon with three blank tags hanging on it: red, yellow, and green. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：脚手架的三色标签，了解即可。

shots.scene: 三个标签依次亮起，旁边对应图标
shots.prompt_en: The red tag with a stop icon, the yellow tag with a harness icon, the green tag with a check icon. No people.
shots.narration: 红不能用，黄要系安全带，绿可用。

shots.scene: 实验室仪器上挂着空白的停用牌
shots.prompt_en: A lab instrument with a blank out-of-service tag hanging on its handle. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室仪器也挂牌：停用就别碰。

shots.scene: 受限空间剖面图，五个危害图标
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section icon of an enclosed tank with five hazard icons inside. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：受限空间有哪些危害？

shots.scene: 井口旁立着警示牌，阿杰绕开走
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks around a manhole with a warning sign beside it.
shots.narration: 这些危害看不见，千万别随便进。

shots.scene: 空气中的氧气图标在减少
shots.prompt_en: An air bubble icon with oxygen symbols fading away and a down arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：什么是缺氧？

shots.scene: 小人图标头晕倒下
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram feeling dizzy and collapsing, with a low oxygen icon. No people.
shots.narration: 氧气低于规定值，人会头晕、窒息。

shots.scene: 墙上的氧含量报警器
shots.prompt_en: A wall-mounted oxygen level alarm next to a liquid nitrogen dewar in a lab. No people.
shots.narration: 用液氮的房间，要看氧含量报警。

shots.scene: 空气中的氧气图标在增多
shots.prompt_en: An air bubble icon filling with extra oxygen symbols and an up arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：什么是富氧？

shots.scene: 富氧环境里小火苗变成大火
shots.prompt_en: A small flame icon growing into a large fierce flame inside an oxygen-rich bubble. No people.
shots.narration: 氧气高于规定值，东西更容易着火。

shots.scene: 氧气瓶阀门漏气图标和油污抹布，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a leaking oxygen cylinder valve next to an oily rag, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 氧气瓶要防漏，远离油脂。

shots.section_title: 刷涂料、用溶剂的安全措施
shots.scene: 老李在刷涂料，旁边放着空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer paints a lab wall with a roller, with a blank data sheet and a paint can nearby.
shots.narration: 第九题：刷涂料、用溶剂要注意什么？
overlay: 刷涂料、用溶剂的安全措施

shots.section_title: 刷涂料、用溶剂的安全措施
shots.scene: 老李翻看空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer reads the blank data sheet before opening the paint can.
shots.narration: 先看安全技术说明书。

shots.section_title: 刷涂料、用溶剂的安全措施
shots.scene: 周围的明火和电焊图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an open flame and a welding torch near paint cans, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 附近不能动火，不能有火源。

shots.section_title: 刷涂料、用溶剂的安全措施
shots.scene: 老李戴口罩、手套、护目镜，开窗通风
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears a respirator mask, gloves and safety glasses while a window is open for ventilation.
shots.narration: 戴好防护，保持通风。

shots.section_title: 刷涂料、用溶剂的安全措施
shots.scene: 涂料桶放在托盘里
shots.prompt_en: A paint can standing inside a spill tray on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 桶下垫托盘，防止洒漏。

shots.section_title: 刷涂料、用溶剂的安全措施
shots.scene: 老李把用完的空桶搬走
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer carries away empty paint cans from the work area.
shots.narration: 不用的桶，及时清走。

shots.scene: 喷砂作业的简笔图标，粉尘飞扬
shots.prompt_en: A simple icon of a sandblasting nozzle spraying grit with clouds of dust. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：喷砂作业有哪些危害？了解。

shots.scene: 粉尘、噪声、振动三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a dust cloud, a sound wave with an ear, and a vibrating hand. No people.
shots.narration: 粉尘、噪声、振动，都伤身体。

shots.scene: 损坏的软管和工具图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cracked hose and a worn nozzle with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 设备损坏，也会伤人。

shots.scene: 铁锹和挖掘机两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a shovel and an excavator. No people.
shots.narration: 第十一题：开挖有哪两种？了解。

shots.scene: 地下电缆和管线的示意，铁锹停住
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section icon of soil with buried cables and pipes, and a shovel stopping above them. No people.
shots.narration: 无论哪种，先查清地下管线。

shots.scene: 配电箱开关上挂着锁和空白牌
shots.prompt_en: A red padlock and a blank tag hanging on an electrical isolator switch. No people.
shots.narration: 第十二题：什么是上锁挂牌？

shots.scene: 老李给仪器断电后上锁挂牌
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches off a lab instrument's isolator and attaches a padlock and a blank tag.
shots.narration: 隔离能量后，上锁挂牌。

shots.scene: 别人伸手去合闸，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand reaching for the locked isolator, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 防止有人误开，伤到检修的人。

shots.scene: 打闹的小人图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two person pictograms pushing each other playfully, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 第十三题：什么是不安全行为？

shots.scene: 不戴手套、护目镜的小人图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person pictogram handling a bottle without gloves or goggles, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 人做出的危险动作，害己也害人。

shots.scene: 阿杰停下来，戴上手套和护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stops joking, puts on his gloves and safety glasses, and stands up straight.
shots.narration: 阿杰的第一个问题：嬉闹、不戴防护。

shots.scene: 杂乱的实验台和堵塞的通道
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cluttered lab bench and a blocked walkway with boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 第十四题：什么是不安全状态？

shots.scene: 温度计显示高温，小人擦汗
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon showing high heat next to a sweating person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 环境让人受伤的隐患，比如高温。

shots.scene: 阿杰把纸箱搬走，通道畅通
shots.prompt_en: The young male student moves the cardboard boxes away, leaving the walkway to the exit clear.
shots.narration: 第二个问题：纸箱堵通道，马上清走。

shots.scene: 小研在空白检查表上打勾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ticks items on a blank checklist and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 发现了就纠正，纠正不了就报告。

shots.section_title: 不独自做高危实验，不无人值守
shots.scene: 夜里的实验室只有一盏灯，一人独自操作，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a dark lab at night with a single person pictogram working alone at a hazardous setup, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 高危实验，不要一个人做。
overlay: 不独自做高危实验，不无人值守

shots.section_title: 不独自做高危实验，不无人值守
shots.scene: 加热装置开着、人离开的图标，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a heating mantle running with an empty chair beside it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 加热、反应进行中，人不能走开。

shots.section_title: 不独自做高危实验，不无人值守
shots.scene: 小研和阿杰两人一起做实验
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student work together at a fume hood, both in lab coats and safety glasses.
shots.narration: 要有同伴，或按规定申请值守。

shots.section_title: 方案变了，先评估再动手
shots.scene: 实验方案卡片上的一步被改动，出现问号
shots.prompt_en: A blank experiment plan card with one step changed and a question mark appearing. No people.
shots.narration: 改试剂、加量、换设备，都是变更。
overlay: 方案变了，先评估再动手

shots.section_title: 方案变了，先评估再动手
shots.scene: 小研拿着改过的方案找老周
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student brings a revised blank plan to the older man, who reviews it at his desk.
shots.narration: 先重新评估风险，再请负责人确认。

shots.section_title: 方案变了，先评估再动手
shots.scene: 直接放大量的反应瓶被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a small flask replaced directly by a much larger flask, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不经评估直接放大，最容易出事。

shots.scene: 实验室里研磨粉末，粉尘飘起
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a mortar and pestle grinding powder with a small dust cloud rising. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室也有粉尘和噪声。

shots.scene: 阿杰在通风橱里称粉末，戴防尘口罩
shots.prompt_en: The young male student weighs a fine powder inside a ventilated enclosure, wearing a dust mask, gloves and safety glasses.
shots.narration: 细粉在通风处操作，戴好防尘口罩。

shots.scene: 老李在机加工间戴耳罩
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears ear muffs and safety glasses while operating a loud machine in a workshop.
shots.narration: 高噪声设备旁，戴耳塞或耳罩。

shots.section_title: 溶剂废液和废包装怎么处理
shots.scene: 溶剂废液倒入下水道，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of solvent waste being poured into a sink drain, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 溶剂废液，严禁倒进下水道。
overlay: 溶剂废液和废包装怎么处理

shots.section_title: 溶剂废液和废包装怎么处理
shots.scene: 阿杰把废液倒入贴空白标签的废液桶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pours solvent waste through a funnel into a waste container with a blank label, wearing gloves and safety glasses.
shots.narration: 分类倒进废液桶，贴好标签。

shots.section_title: 溶剂废液和废包装怎么处理
shots.scene: 空试剂瓶和涂料桶放进指定回收箱
shots.prompt_en: Empty reagent bottles and paint cans placed into a designated collection box with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 空瓶空桶也是危险废物。

shots.section_title: 溶剂废液和废包装怎么处理
shots.scene: 王老师在收运单上签字
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs a blank collection form as waste containers are lined up for pickup.
shots.narration: 交学校统一收集，有资质的单位处置。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现规程手册和许可单
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a blank procedure book and a blank permit form.
shots.narration: 按制度干活，危险作业办许可。

shots.scene: 红线、挂锁、停用牌图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a red line, a padlock with a blank tag, and a blank out-of-service tag. No people.
shots.narration: 红线不碰，检修上锁，停用挂牌。

shots.scene: 打叉的打闹图标和清爽的通道图标
shots.prompt_en: A crossed-out horseplay icon next to a clear walkway icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 不嬉闹、戴防护，通道保持畅通。

shots.scene: 同伴、评估单、废液桶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of two person pictograms together, a blank risk assessment form, and a labeled waste container. No people.
shots.narration: 不独做高危实验，变更先评估。

shots.scene: 欣欣在问答台后挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye from behind the quiz desk with the question-mark lamp.
shots.narration: 十五题答完了，下期再见！
